producerAndContracts.roleCreateAndUpdate: RoleManager validates through RoleValidator, updates NormalizedName, then calls real store Create/Update, which assigns the exact supplied role object by Id. Default validator rejects null/empty/whitespace and duplicate normalized role names found through RoleManager.FindByName.
producerAndContracts.publicSetName: RoleManager.SetRoleNameAsync directly mutates Name and normalized property without calling validator or store Update. Stored object reference makes this mutation immediately visible. Actual public setter rows prove duplicate/null/empty transient states and subsequent validating Update outcomes; no claim that successful default validated Create produces them.
producerAndContracts.userMembership: UserManager normalizes role input. Add checks IsInRole first, calls AddToRole, then UpdateUser. Remove checks membership and can return UserNotInRole without reaching leaf removal. IsInRole and GetUsersInRole also normalize; GetUsersInRole guards null input before store call.
producerAndContracts.mutationAndReferenceCostsObserved: Same-object set/update, replacement-object update at same Id, role deletion retaining user association, same-Id re-creation rebinding association, and separate new-Id case after old association cleanup. These establish concrete mutable-reference/lifetime consistency boundaries, not an index design prescription.
